positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Under the G/ATOR program, supported porting of the radar signal processor code base,
middleware libraries, and associated engineering tools to new x86 and Linux architectures. 

-Implemented further optimizations to the signal processor code base allowing the radar to run at full speed with a max capacity scenario. 

-Supported multiple remote testing and regression testing events. Was able to setup and debug technical issues with the testing environment alongside guiding Marines on radar operations.

-Regularly worked on G/ATOR related software Stories, divided by 4-week sprints, submitted through Jira by creating and maintaining a code branch using GIT commands. Using
Collaborator, code changes were submitted for review and updated based on feedback from peers.

positions.title: Software Enginner Intern
positions.description:
● Implemented unit tests for various modules in ​C​ for a ​RTOS​ based defense project. 
● Re-factored old ​java script​ source code into the ​Angular 6​ framework for a web server.  
● Tested hardware per protocol in order to confirm that it met the listed specifications. 
● Practiced ​Agile​ and ​Scrum​ in 2 week sprints with 15 other developers. 
● Researched ​private/public key ​encryption for an authentication service module

positions.title: Student Consultant
positions.description:
● Served as ﬁrst point of contact for students seeking resolutions to computer related issues. 
● Troubleshooted computer system issues such as viruses and hardware failures. 
● Enforced appropriate usage of lab, software, and other computer resources.
